name: Casa de Montejo

dates.altered: 'modificada durante los siglos XIX y XX'; Manuel de Arrigunaga y Gutierrez altered the facade to modernise it after 1914; adapted as bank offices by Banamex from 1981 and turned into a house museum in December 2010 under INAH supervision.
dates.note: The infobox's construction field, '1542 - 1549, modificada durante los siglos XIX y XX', agrees with the node's exemplar exactly. THE FACADE WAS ALTERED IN THE 20TH CENTURY, which matters for a record whose whole interest is the portada.

refs.title: Casa de los Montejo: INAH monumento histórico, Código I-0013101353, as the Spanish Wikipedia infobox prints it
refs.note: THE CODE IS CARRIED IN THIS TITLE AND NOT IN AN `id` FIELD, DELIBERATELY. `check_precedents.py` shapes an id per kind and names the kinds it does not shape; there is no `inah` kind and no shape rule for a Mexican catalogue number, so putting the code in `id` on a kind the checker treats as id-less would make it an identifier nobody validates and nobody knows about. It is the Catálogo Nacional de Monumentos Históricos Inmuebles number as the infobox prints it, and it was not read on an INAH page.

quotes.text: Hacia fines de 1839 la compró Simón Peón y Peón, quien al fallecer en 1869 la legó a su viuda, quien a su vez la transfirió a su hijo, José María Peón Losa. Después, en 1914, la heredó María Eduviges Peón y Peón, casada con Manuel de Arrigunaga y Gutiérrez, quien modificó la fachada del edificio para modernizarla.
